newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Upwards for BTPs after 129.95 is pierced.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Upwards for BTPs after 129.95 is pierced.

text.p: June BTP futures on LIFFE broke through long-held resistance in early trade, giving them the opportunity for a push to February highs around 130.75, technical analysts said.

"A break through 129.95 confirms a rally up to 130.70,75 short term and then a test of the contract high at 131.76," Francoise Skelly, head of global trading technical analysis at Credit Suisse First Boston in London.
BTPs were quoted at 130.18 at 0819 GMT, up 64 basis points, and well above Tuesday's high at 129.93. The contract hit a 129.96 high on February 26 before sliding down.
Skelley said BTPs would now aim for the 130.70/75 area, highs on February 24 and 25 respectively.
On the downside, five minute charts give support at 130.05 while the 129.95 area would now also act as support, she said.
Below there, the bottom of the trading range in the last few days around 129.50/40 would act as an additional buffer, she said.
A trader at a European house on the LIFFE floor said BTPs were likely to come off in later trade after smartly rejecting the 130.27 level.
A correction would push them back intitially to 129.00 and then 128.87, the low from May 12.
"However if they manage to retest 130.27 and then defeat it, it will take them to 130.40, highs we saw in February. Then 130.70,75 is the next clear target," she added.
At the short end, June Eurolire futures were quoted at 93.27, up five basis points on the day.
